observation_summary: The mock object failed to serialize because the internal logic for determining serializability was flawed. It relied on checking if 'Serializable.class' was present in the extra interfaces list, which was insufficient for the CGLIB-generated proxy classes.
reasoning_summary: The fix involved changing the internal logic for how serializability is tracked and applied to the mock object. Instead of relying on the 'extraInterfaces' list as a proxy for serializability, the code now explicitly tracks a 'serializable' boolean flag and uses this to correctly construct the 'ancillaryTypes' array. This is a correction of the procedural logic used to configure the mock object, fitting the Algorithm/Method category.
evidence_used: The fix adds a 'serializable' boolean field to MockSettingsImpl.
The fix updates MockSettingsImpl.isSerializable() to return the boolean flag instead of checking the extraInterfaces list.
The fix updates MockUtil to use the 'isSerializable()' check to correctly append Serializable.class to the ancillaryTypes array.

alternative_types.why_not_primary: While a new boolean field was added, the core issue was the procedural logic that determined how the mock was configured (the algorithm for setting up ancillary types), not just a simple initialization error.
The fix is a local procedural correction within existing classes to ensure correct configuration, not a design-level capability gap.
